label: Commercial / Product
description: Short product-led promos driven by proof, hierarchy, and a clear call to action.
intent: Show the actual product benefit clearly and avoid unverifiable claims.
opening: Show a real benefit or the product in actual use, supported by supplied evidence.
editing: Problem → demonstration/proof → concise offer → next action.
typography: One strong claim per composition; consistent brand tokens.
sound: Audio reinforces product actions without masking proof.
critique: Does every promise have evidence and is the product unmistakable?

creative_contrast.when: A new idea, action or visual fact arrives
The viewer needs to read, understand or feel something
